neighbours.label: The word 'cell' in the compound 'fuel cell'.
fire: The fuel cell converts hydrogen into electricity for the vehicle.
Engineers tested a fuel cell under several operating temperatures.
Water is produced when the fuel cell combines hydrogen and oxygen.
The laboratory measured the voltage of the fuel cell.
The bus carries a compact fuel cell beneath its floor.
Fresh hydrogen flows continuously into the fuel cell.
A damaged membrane reduced the efficiency of the fuel cell.
The team connected the fuel cell to an external circuit.

Fresh hydrogen flows continuously into the electrochemical generator.
A damaged membrane reduced the efficiency of the electrochemical generator.
The team connected the electrochemical generator to an external circuit.
